feature: INTERCITY-ENTRY — passenger service-type selection (City ride / Intercity)
status: IMPLEMENTED + unit/widget-tested (local); no staging/device verification (billing down)
why_this_feature: Audit §3 'Known failures' listed 'Home Intercity / Courier / Move → NOT STARTED (placeholders)'. Backend contract already existed end-to-end (estimate validates ride|courier|intercity|move; createRide persists serviceType; listRides filters it; open rides display it) — the gap was pure client wiring, implementable offline with zero backend/staging/billing dependency. Courier/Move deliberately left 'Coming later' — parcel/moving product semantics differ and would be faked by a label alone.

mobile/lib/features/ride/presentation/vi: kRideRequestServiceTypes = {ride, intercity} — UI-exposed subset of the server's 4-value enum
seedServiceType() — deep-link seeding, validates + ignores junk
_estimateServiceType tracking — estimate response does not echo serviceType, so stale-guard compares it alongside category
estimate request sends serviceType; create body sends state.serviceType (was hardcoded 'ride')
initialServiceType ctor param, seeded post-frame alongside category
_ServiceTypeSelector chips (OraChip selected/onTap) in compose + review panes
mobile/lib/features/passenger/presentati: Intercity promo card → compose with serviceType=intercity (eyebrow COMING LATER → NOW AVAILABLE)
Services-grid Intercity tile → compose; Courier/Move still onUnavailable

backend_changes: NONE — contract pre-existed (estimate_service.ts enum validation, createRide storage, list filter, publicRide/publicOpenRide serialization, driver open-ride + history display via historyServiceTypeLabel)

tests.passenger_suite: 15 pass / 1 fail — home_shell_driver_gate FirebaseMessaging unmocked, verified pre-existing at pristine HEAD
tests.test_harness_note: autoDispose c.read(provider) recreates a fresh instance across awaits; tests asserting state after awaits must hold c.listen() — consistent with existing test at line ~430

verification_round_2026_10_19.flow_trace: Home promo/grid → ?service=intercity → seedServiceType → _ServiceTypeSelector (compose+review) → estimate request.serviceType → stale-guard (_estimateServiceType) → create body.serviceType → publicRide.serviceType → historyServiceTypeLabel on passenger history/detail + driver open rides + both active-ride trip cards
gaps_fixed: backend createRide: serviceType was any non-empty string — now enum-validated (ride|courier|intercity|move), same as estimate

backend createRide: new PRICING_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH (422) when body.serviceType or body.category disagree with snapshot.inputs — closes stale/mismatched-snapshot submission server-side; absent inputs on old snapshots skip the check
active_ride_view + driver_assigned_ride_view trip cards now show '<service> · Category <cat>' (was category only)
verification_round_2026_10_19.stale_estimate_proof: client: selectServiceType → _invalidatePricing synchronously blocks canSubmitRideRequest (pricingUnavailable) until refetch lands; failed refetch stays blocked (2 new tests). server: PRICING_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH rejects any mismatched create regardless of client state (2 new backend tests)
verification_round_2026_10_19.no_gap: RideRequestCreatedView carries no service label but is unreachable — submit path navigates straight to offers inbox

tests_after_verification.rides_test: 89/89 incl. 2 new (enum rejection+intercity accept, snapshot mismatch+match)

limitations: No staging/device verification — staging down (billing disabled); driver-visible intercity label relies on existing verified display path
Intercity pricing = same per-city category rules (server-authoritative); no intercity-specific fare model invented
Ride created intercity rides are filterable via GET /v1/rides?serviceType=intercity and display 'Intercity' in history/open-rides
next_feature: Courier/Move product definition (needs owner semantics), or live push verification once billing restores
safety: No backend edits, no cloud/billing/deploy/commit/push, frozen state machines untouched, payout fields unchanged
